item.title: Public backlash against data centers is rising. Politicians are playing catchup
item.description: Public sentiment against data centers is running high this election season, leaving politicians of all stripes scrambling to respond. We look at how this is playing out in Pennsylvania.
item.content:encoded: Public sentiment against data centers is running high this election season, leaving politicians of all stripes scrambling to respond. We look at how this is playing out in Pennsylvania.

item.title: Politics chat: First-ever Republican midterm convention or Trump rally?
item.description: A first-ever Republican midterm convention is taking place this week in Dallas, but are candidates interested in attending? Plus, Michigan's Democratic senate candidate apologizes to Jewish voters.

item.title: U.S. envoys Witkoff and Kushner land for talks in Kyiv after meeting Putin in Moscow
item.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are set to arrive in Kyiv on Sunday in their first visit to the Ukrainian capital as part of a renewed push for peace in Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

item.title: Trump administration to dig at triumphal arch site despite no final federal approvals
item.description: The Trump administration says it will break ground on a 250-foot triumphal arch in Washington, D.C., without final federal approval and despite an ongoing lawsuit.

item.title: Week in Politics: Trump's face on the coin; reshaping the capital; the midterms
item.description: President Trump is the first living president to have his face on a coin. He's also reshaping Washington in his image, and working to influence midterm elections.

item.title: Voters are fed up with data centers. Both parties are trying to cash in for midterms
item.description: Democrats and Republicans have found common ground in this campaign season. Both parties have poured millions into ads attacking data centers as the public continues to protest the AI facilities.

item.description: The new effort appears to be another tactic in a broader Trump administration strategy to short-circuit immigrants' already limited due process options in order to speed deportations.
